messages.content: You can call search_flights to find flights matching the user's needs.
Find me a direct flight from Beijing to San Francisco next Monday, economy class, under $1500.

message.content:
<think>The user wants to find a direct flight from Beijing (PEK) to San Francisco (SFO) next Monday in economy class under $15,000. Let me figure out the date for next Monday.

Today's date is 2024-05-17 (Friday). So next Monday would be 2024-05-20.

I have all the required parameters:
- from_airport: PEK
- to_airport: SFO
- depart_date: 2024-05-20
- cabin_class: economy
- direct_only: true
- max_price_usd: 15000

Let me make the search.
</think>


<minimax:tool_call>
<invoke name="search_flights">
<parameter name="from_airport">PEK</parameter>
<parameter name="to_airport">SFO</parameter>
<parameter name="depart_date">2024-05-20</parameter>
<parameter name="max_price_usd">15000</parameter>
<parameter name="cabin_class">economy</parameter>
<parameter name="direct_only">true</parameter>
</invoke>
</minimax:tool_call>
